limits: Logical native group partitions are not combined hard macros/group LEF.
Native/SRAM complete physical timing views still required for combined mapping/STA and physical implementation.
SDC interface harness checks syntax, actual port objects and serialized values; no meaningful timing paths or WNS/TNS.
Generic synthesis -noabc is structural verification, not standard-cell mapped timing acceptance.
No new functional RTL replay; previous bounded matrix evidence retained.
No complete model frontend, arbitrary scheduling/topology/numeric conversion, multi-clock CDC/RDC or power gating.
